title: King James Version
tradition_notes: The Authorized (King James) Version, commissioned by King James I for the Church of England and first published in 1611; the 1769 Blayney standardized text is the basis of this edition. Long the standard English Bible across Protestant traditions.
source_edition: King James Version, 1769 Blayney standard text (original 1611); public domain. Verse text from the scrollmapper bible_databases KJV dataset (Strong's/morphology data not ingested).
notes: Public domain. Book names normalized from source to canonical OSIS names.
